positions.name: VerifiedCalibrationClaim
positions.frame: what is the verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, and against what reference standard does it hold?
positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same directional read: the Kestrelwood spectrograph's 88.4 MHz calibration is asserted as settled and verified against the June reference plates. src-1 states this in prose with evidential backing ('verified... and it holds across the full observing band'); src-2 and src-3 restate the identical claim in flat labelled-field form ('Instrument: Kestrelwood spectrograph', 'Calibration: 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates'). The register observations mark all three under the same flat-technical-cataloguing signature, and the conviction reads are uniform plain-assertion with no hedging — three renderings of one verified-state claim, not three separate stances.
